item.title: Critical Red Hat Quay Flaw Lets Attackers Read and Overwrite All Private Container Images in a Registry
item.description: A critical flaw in Red Hat Quay allows an attacker who can access a Quay registry to read and overwrite private container images in every repository. item.title: WhiteArmor gang claims responsibility for latest cyber attack on shipping giant Maersk
item.description: Shipping giant Maersk has confirmed that one of its systems was broken into by hackers who have stolen data. The WhiteArmor gang has claimed responsbility for the attack. Read more in my article on the Hot for Security blog.
